title: Modern GEODATA DWG UnitsValue domain
scope: For GEODATA object versions 2 and 3, DWG output accepts horizontal and vertical UnitsValue values 0 through 24. Invalid values fail before low-level body/string/handle buffers mutate and before dwgWriter15 prepares caller identity or stages a custom class. Version 1 remains on its distinct layout and is not constrained by the modern pair of unit fields.

normativeSources.title: Autodesk GEODATA (DXF)
normativeSources.groups: Groups 91 and 92 use the UnitsValue enumeration.

normativeSources.title: Autodesk UnitsValue Enumeration
normativeSources.domain: Undefined through USSurveyMile are contiguous enum values 0 through 24.

normativeSources.title: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, §20.4.78
normativeSources.scope: The GEODATA v2/v3 body serializes horizontal and vertical unit fields; this change validates their value domain without changing the encoding layout.

implementation.behavior: DRW_GeoData::encodeDwg rejects modern unit values outside 0..24 before touching output buffers. dwgWriter15::writeGeoData repeats the check before handle/class staging.

regressionControl.coverage: For v2 and v3, each horizontal and vertical field rejects -1 and 25 with sentinel-prefilled body, string and handle buffers unchanged; retry with the same object/buffers at valid endpoints 0 or 24 succeeds. Controls are authored in memory.

nonClaims: No physical producer or native geospatial consumer was qualified.
This does not qualify graph closure, map projection behavior or DWG output semantics beyond the tested enum domains and existing GEODATA vectors.
